expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第3–5天无任何数据，之后恢复。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 3–5: no data at all, then recovery.

ground_truth.zh: 数据源中断48小时；设备健康。

expected_health_response.zh: 中断期间 UNKNOWN（INSUFFICIENT_DATA）；恢复后 NORMAL，恢复时不得误报；增量读取从水位线继续。
expected_health_response.en: UNKNOWN during the gap (INSUFFICIENT_DATA); NORMAL after recovery with no false alarm; incremental reads resume from the watermark.
